channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: mpv-android
item.description: Powerful video player: lagbhag har format, subtitles, speed control, gestures — bina ads.

item.title: Flameshot
item.description: Screenshot lo aur turant arrows, text, blur, highlight laga do — notes/tutorials ke liye.

item.title: DigiLocker
item.description: Government ki official app: Aadhaar, PAN, DL, CBSE marksheet/certificates digital — originals jitne valid.

item.title: Just (Video) Player
item.description: Simple video player: double-tap se seek, swipe se volume/brightness, subtitles, picture-in-picture.

item.title: ShareX
item.description: Windows pe screenshot, screen recording, GIF banana, text OCR — sab ek free tool me.

item.title: Briar
item.description: Bina internet ke chat: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi se paas wale dosto ko message, internet ho to Tor se. Na phone number, na central server.

item.title: VSCodium
item.description: VS Code ka open-source build bina Microsoft telemetry ke — same editor, same feel.

item.title: FairEmail
item.description: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo — saare email ek inbox me, privacy ke saath: tracking images block, phishing warning.

item.title: Thonny
item.description: Python seekhne ke liye sabse simple IDE: Python saath me aata hai, step-by-step debugger dikhata hai code kaise chalta hai.

item.title: DuckDuckGo Browser
item.description: Privacy browser: trackers block karta hai, ek Fire button se saara browsing data turant saaf.

item.title: Librera Reader
item.description: PDF, EPUB, MOBI, DjVu sab padhne wala reader: night mode, bookmarks, aur text-to-speech se book padh ke sunata bhi hai.

item.title: KOReader
item.description: E-book/PDF reader jo PDF ko reflow karke chhoti screen pe padhne layak bana deta hai; dictionary lookup, highlights.

item.title: draw.io
item.description: Flowchart, ER diagram, network diagram, mind map — free, browser ya desktop app me.

item.title: Material Files
item.description: Clean file manager: ZIP/7z/RAR archives kholo, FTP/SMB/SFTP se PC ki files, root support bhi.

item.title: Notepad++
item.description: Windows ka fast code/text editor: syntax highlighting, tabs, find-replace, plugins.

item.title: Fossify Music Player
item.description: Offline music player: playlists, equalizer, sleep timer, widget. No ads.

item.title: Penpot
item.description: Browser me UI/UX design aur prototyping, team ke saath — open-source Figma jaisa.

item.title: Musicolet
item.description: Offline music player: no ads, internet permission hi nahi, multiple queues, lyrics, tag editor.

item.title: Fossify Calculator
item.description: Saaf-suthra calculator with history, bina ads. Daily hisaab aur basic padhai ke liye.

item.title: Excalidraw
item.description: Hand-drawn style whiteboard browser me: diagrams, flowcharts, notes — dosto ke saath live.

item.title: Fossify Contacts
item.description: Contacts app jo contacts phone pe hi rakhta hai: groups, favourites, vCard import/export, no ads.

item.title: HandBrake
item.description: Video converter: badi video ko chhota (compress) karo ya MP4/MKV me convert — quality bachake.

item.title: Fossify Messages
item.description: Ad-free SMS/MMS app: number aur keyword se spam block, messages export/import, clean design.

item.title: Fossify Phone
item.description: Dialer app: call blocking, speed dial, call history — bina ads aur tracking ke.

item.title: darktable
item.description: RAW photo editor: DSLR/phone RAW photos ka colour grading, exposure, presets.

item.title: Kdenlive
item.description: Free video editor: multitrack timeline, transitions, titles, keyframes, proxy editing — YouTube videos ke liye.

item.title: Fossify Notes
item.description: Simple notes + checklist app, home screen widget ke saath. No ads, no tracking.

item.title: Shotcut
item.description: Simple free video editor: cut, filters, text, colour correction, 4K support, no watermark.

item.title: Fossify Clock
item.description: Alarm, timer, stopwatch aur world clock ek simple app me — bina ads ke.

item.title: OpenShot
item.description: Beginners ke liye easy video editor: drag-drop, titles, transitions, animations — no watermark.
